formulas.formula: Plan for baby with confidence: gear, birth costs, leave, savings and the first year.
1. Setup: add the due date, your monthly take-home pay and what you've already saved for baby.
2. Baby Gear: your checklist. Set a budget for each item, tick Got It when you buy it, or Gift when someone gives it to you.
3. Birth & Medical: estimate each bill and what insurance pays. Add your out-of-pocket max to cap your share.
4. Leave Planner: weeks off for each parent and how much is paid. It works out the income gap.
5. Monthly Costs: diapers, formula, daycare and more, with the month each one starts.
6. Baby Fund: your savings target and how much to save each month until the due date. Log every deposit.
7. First Year and Dashboard: month-by-month costs after baby arrives, and everything at a glance.
Baby Fund target = gear still to buy + birth bills left + leave income gap + a cushion of monthly baby costs.
Tick Gift for anything from your registry, shower or hand-me-downs. It drops off your to-buy total.
Full-pay weeks come first, then partial pay, then unpaid. Leave starts on the due date unless you pick a day.
First Year month 1 is the month baby is due.
Took money out of the Baby Fund? Log it as a negative amount.
Clear the white cells on every tab, then update Setup.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: done, on track, or a gift.
Yellow: still to buy, or a thank-you to send.
Red: over budget, or something to check.
Thank you for your purchase, and congratulations!
